_what: SAFE OBSERVATIONS section (#what-to-check): the heading numeral + lede, the 5 tool-free checks, the two safety sheets' items (never / stop-and-call), and the section's own centre CTA text. Design doc §4.2 rows 24-26.
heading_html: 5 things to check now that could save you a service call
lede: On their own, a thermostat reading and a photo of your filter are just notes. The LIVE walkthrough asks the follow-ups, structures what you saw, and hands you a packet you can send to whoever comes next.

checks.h: Your thermostat, exactly as it reads
checks.p: Mode, set point, room temperature, any code. Check the fan is on AUTO, not ON. A photo answers all of it.
If it looks dirty, show us the filter and its label. We read the size off it and name the replacement.

checks.h: Your outdoor unit, from a distance
checks.p: Is the top fan spinning? Is it buried in clippings? One wide photo from a few feet back. Do not open it.
Ice on the larger insulated pipe means switch cooling off, leave the fan running, let it thaw before anyone tests anything.
Whole house or one end? Any registers closed or blocked? The answer splits the causes in two.

never_items: Open an electrical compartment or test a live circuit
Touch a capacitor. They hold a charge with the power off
Add refrigerant or open any sealed part
Take a panel off the indoor or outdoor unit
stop_items: You smell burning, see smoke or see sparking. Cut power at the breaker first
The breaker trips again after you reset it once
Water is pooling near anything electrical
The heat is dangerous for an infant, an older adult, or someone unwell
cta: Walk me through MY AC instead
